idea-plugin.name: DevSnip Pro: API Client & Developer Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
DevSnip Pro for JetBrains IDEs: everything in the DevSnip Pro VS Code extension, with the same look, Tools sidebar and themes. A REST and GraphQL API client, a database client, 100 developer tools for backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps, security, AI & ML and RAG work, vulnerability scanners, snippets, debug-log tools, and points, milestones and rewards as you work.

  • REST API Client: HTTP, GraphQL and WebSocket requests, environments with {{variables}}, collections, history, cURL, OAuth 2.0, and the Software Developer and AI & ML tools
  • Database Client: PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, ClickHouse, MongoDB and Redis: browse, edit rows and run queries
  • OSV Vulnerability Scanner and SCA Scanner for npm, PyPI, Maven, Gradle, Go, Cargo, NuGet, Composer, RubyGems and more
  • Security: workspace, cloud & container and dependency audits, and an endpoint scanner
  • 100 toolkit tools: cURL converter, JSON/YAML/XML, JWT, regex, Docker, Kubernetes, CI, LLM tokens and cost, RAG planning and more
  • Code & productivity: snippets in code completion, Insert / Clean Debug Logs, unused imports, README manager, dependencies & installation
  • CSV & Excel viewer with editing, and Milestones & Points with quests, streaks, rewards and themes to unlock

Open the DevSnip Pro tool window, use Tools | DevSnip Pro, or Find Action (“DevSnip Pro: …”). The tools run locally. The network is used only by what you ask for: the API client (the URLs you enter), the database client (your servers), the scanners (package names and versions to OSV.dev, registries and Maven Central; CVE ids to NVD), the endpoint scanner (the URL you scan), dependency lookups, and anonymous usage statistics only if you turn them on. No account needed.
